brief:
Israel's far-right Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich has ordered Israeli forces to demolish numerous Palestinian buildings around Hebron's northern entrance, Middle East Eye reported. The demolitions follow a shooting incident in the area, according to Channel 12.

The order targets structures near the site of the incident, though further details on the shooting and the scope of planned demolitions were not immediately available.
dek: Smotrich orders Palestinian building demolitions near Hebron shooting site Israel’s Channel 12 reports that far-right Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich has ordered Israeli forces to demolish numerous Palestinian buildings around Hebron’s northern entrance…
title: Smotrich orders demolition of Palestinian buildings near Hebron
